escena: SCENE (after a long selection, design studio in Lima, evening, NO faces): THE SUBJECT IS WHAT WAS NOT CHOSEN — verify it by these landmarks: a deep, untidy PILE of rejected printed proofs fills the centre and lower half of the frame, dozens of sheets overlapping at every angle on the floor beside a worktop, some creased, some face-down, some with ORANGE grease-pencil crosses on them; the pile is the largest and most detailed thing in the picture. The one sheet that WAS chosen is NOT in the frame: only the empty pin on the wall above, and a single sheet already gone. Nobody is present. A low hard lamp rakes across the pile from the left so every edge of paper casts its own shadow and the depth of the stack is legible. The cyan and ink-blue halftone fields of the printed proofs give the picture its blue. 35mm at f/4, camera low beside the pile. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the nearest creased proof sheet lying right against the lens, out of focus
lecho.tono: DARK, in deep shadow, matte paper texture
